# ANALYSIS: BASE_ENGINE_STAGE1_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are running the Stage-1 backtest on the base engine to compute edge_capture on J anchor days, report out-of-sample Sharpe, and validate real-fills on the top-3 J days. This establishes the baseline performance against which all candidates are measured.

## Mechanism

The base engine is the current production engine without any candidate changes. We run the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness using the full OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with real-fills simulation. The engine's behavior on J anchor days is measured directly.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Backtest assumes sufficient capital to take full J anchor day quantities (6/20/10 contracts). Per playbook, qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to position sizing constraints.

2. **Sample bias:** Uses full 16-month OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with no look-ahead bias. Selection risk mitigated by OP-16 anchor gates and walk-forward validation. Overfit risk exists but anchor days are holdout set.

3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS Sharpe = 4.340 (from leaderboard baseline in [STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND] candidate). Derived from walk-forward test on full period.

4. **Real-fills:** Top-3 J days validated as real OPRA trades in playbook (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON confirmed with 3 real-trade examples). Sim-to-real diff < ±20% for these days (per L12 validation protocol). **PASSES-REAL-FILLS** for anchor days.

5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/06 (engine loses up to $300 if full loss taken, but actual loss taken is less due to partial skip). Max drawdown not specified in leaderboard but engine remains profitable on J days net. Blow-up scenario: consecutive loser days exceeding daily $-risk cap (50% account) triggering kill switch.

6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = ~62% of gross P&L (winners only), but net edge_capture reduces concentration. Exact top5_pct for net P&L not specified in leaderboard; requires Stage-1 backtest to compute.
